emails.subject: Re: Fwd: Your auto policy renewal is ready
emails.content:
Hi Ray,

Good question, and you're right that nothing changed on your end. Your record is clean and the coverage is the same as last term.

What you're seeing is a rate change. State Farm filed new auto rates in Arizona this year, and most of my clients are seeing an increase at renewal. The biggest reason is repair costs. Parts, paint and labor all cost more than they did a couple of years ago, and even a small bumper repair can mean sensors and recalibration now. That shows up mostly in the liability and collision parts of your premium. For the Accord it comes to about $44 more for the six months, or $7.38 a month.

If you want to bring it down, two options:
1. Raise the comprehensive and collision deductibles from $500 to $1,000.
2. Try Drive Safe & Save, our app discount based on how you drive.

I'd keep the roadside coverage either way. Happy to run the numbers on either one.

Lorena

emails.subject: Re: Washer grinding during spin, model WTW5000DW
emails.content:
Hello Ray,

Thanks for your follow-up. Without a technician looking at the washer we can't say for sure, but on top-load washers like yours a grinding noise during spin usually comes from one of these:

- Something caught between the wash basket and the outer tub, like a coin or a bra underwire
- A worn part in the drive system, such as the drive pulley or the gearcase
- A worn tub bearing

The first one is a quick fix. The other two are bigger repairs, and the technician can give you a price after the diagnosis. The Use and Care Guide for your model also has a section on noises you may hear.

If you'd like to book the visit, the scheduling link in my last email still works, or just reply here and we'll set it up.

Kind regards,
Kendra

Case 08174231

emails.subject: receta de enchiladas para el cumple de Mateo
emails.content:
Mijo,

Here is the recipe for the enchiladas rojas that Mateo likes so much. He told me when the kids were here for the fall break that he wants them for his birthday, so I am sending it so Dana has it too. I will come that Thursday at 4 to make the sauce with you, and Dana can help when she gets home from work. Your father can drop me of. Tell Dana not to buy the can sauce ok, we make it with the chiles.

ENCHILADAS ROJAS (alcanza para unos 10)
8 chiles guajillo
3 chiles ancho
2 dientes de ajo
1/4 de cebolla
1 cucharadita de oregano
1/2 cucharadita de comino
sal
2 cucharadas de aceite
24 tortillas de maiz
2 lbs de queso, the monterey jack Lucia likes
1 cebolla picada
crema y lechuga for the top

Clean the chiles, take off the stems and shake them out, and boil them 10 minutes. Blend with the ajo, cebolla, oregano, comino and 2 cups of the water from the chiles, then strain it. Fry the sauce in the oil 5 minutes and put salt. Pass the tortillas quick in hot oil and then in the sauce, fill with cheese and onion and roll them. Put more sauce and cheese on top and in the oven at 350 for 15 minutes.

Not too spicy for Lucia!!

Que Dios los bendiga, los quiero mucho
Mom

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone
